title: Required candidate dependency partition
objective: Partition a required candidate dependency; identify safe versus unsafe admission decisions.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result

preconditions.candidate: Fictional candidate-v2 epoch 2; required service path partitioned by a fixed teaching record
preconditions.survivor: Retained old-v1 epoch 1; health, compatibility and effective routing require observed fixture evidence

expectedAssertions: Required candidate-path partition requires removing candidate admission and retaining a usable compatible destination.
Healthy HTTP 200 alone is insufficient when saved-state/effect compatibility fails.
Later repair and removal never erase earlier interrupted candidate trials.
Missing effective gate, routing, client and recovery facts remain unknown.
Unknown intended candidate trials remain counted without success credit.
Old-only arrivals and separate recovery validation probes never become migration credit.
Strict deterministic replay validation rejects forged state and preserves six immutable attempts.
Actual keyboard, error, failure, unknown, reset and enforced CSP checks use isolated local browser sessions.
limits: Dependency partitions, admission actions, routing and recovery are fixed synthetic teaching data, NEVER real networking or resource operations.
No cloud, IaC, scaffold, identity, credentials, deployment, spend, packages, framework or shared/root edits.
Existing Node22 / offline Playwright1.56.1 / signed installed Edge156 test tooling only.
Published isolated helper only; its documented lifecycle limitation remains, without using the abandoned prototype.
No production Node24, native B-S095, actual dependency/network/admission certification, D-S022 or D-S095 completion, or five-nines guarantee.
One frozen S unit; parent-only empirical acceptance; no additional testing/plumbing/refinement credit.
